sub_indicators.label: Private money for digital businesses
sub_indicators.subject: finance.new
sub_indicators.text: Mobilisation of non-state finance: private money for digital businesses
criteria: A source from 2024 or later says no private money has gone into the country's digital businesses, or that investors have withdrawn.

From 2024 on, a named amount was lent to, invested in, guaranteed for or granted to a private digital business, fund or partnership in the country, or a company said what it was investing there itself. Money to the state, and memoranda and plans, do not count.
Such amounts were signed or started in two different years from 2024. Two in one year hold a country at stage 2, whatever else it has.

From 2024 on, a named amount came from a bank, pension fund, insurer, investor or company of the country itself, or was raised by a bond or share issue on the country's own market. The state's own funds do not count.

From 2024 on, the government signed a public-private partnership, concession or joint venture in which the private partner puts a named amount into a public digital project, or private investors paid into a state fund.
